title: Three Three Six
style: industrial electronic, 126 BPM, number as identity hook, signal broadcast theme, punchy staccato, dry male vocal close-mic, bass drop on the number, ZYNTHIO live signal energy, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — signal tone, then beat drops]
Three. Three. Six.

[VERSE 1]
Not a playlist count — a signal
Not a number — a live broadcast
Three three six channels running
Every one of them built to last
CoreyAI on the endpoint
ZYNCONTEXT on the layer
MOSOKO on the voice line
ZYNTHIO — the prayer

[CHORUS]
Three three six — the signal's live
Three three six — we still survive
Three three six — every channel
Three three six — manual
Human in the loop — always
Three three six — every day

[VERSE 2]
The UI said 336 tracks
Some people said that can't be right
The UI lied — the real count's real
336 was the vision — not the slight
Every song a signal
Every lyric logged
Every kits.ai voice
Every session — catalogued

[OUTRO]
Three three six. Live.
